script_text: Stop everything, Capricorn, because Saturn is forcing a massive awakening this week. The turning point occurs when the Sun enters your 7th House, shifting your focus entirely to partnerships. From Thursday through Sunday, Venus sextiles Saturn, smoothing your professional path and attracting wealthy admirers. Your weekend is filled with harmonious energy, rewarding your patience with tangible Earth element manifestations. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun trines your natal Mercury in the 11th House. Tuesday is your worst day because of the Mars-Uranus square. Trust your powerful Saturnian discipline to navigate any sudden shifts without panic. Follow for daily updates.
